body:
Q-A STRAWMAN REVIEW — KEEP THE SET-LEVEL ASSIGNMENT FAMILY; SIX CLAIMS DO NOT YET HOLD

This is the right level of object: one provider-call observation set against one lawful latent exact plan, with misses, false positives, location error and one-to-one association. It is a serious candidate for Q-A. It is not yet a normalized probability model, a posterior, or proof that all agreed courts hold.

1. THE DISPLAYED EXPRESSION IS NOT YET p(O | H).

`f` is called a false-positive intensity but appears as a dimensionless factor per unmatched gap. A point-process/set likelihood needs a declared finite gap domain or base measure and a normalized clutter/count law (including its zero-event term and the appropriate set/cardinality convention). `d` already controls misses and `f` already controls extra detections; an unrestricted `c(n,m)` can double-count both and make `(d,f,c)` non-identifiable.

Required court: on a tiny finite gap lattice, enumerate EVERY observation set O and prove `sum_O p(O | H,theta) = 1` for several H, including empty H/O. Then parameter-recovery courts must show which of d, location kernel, clutter/count law and any over-segmentation effect are separately identifiable. Until then call the expression an unnormalized association score, not a likelihood.

2. C3 PLAN ADMISSION IS SUPPORT, NOT A PRIOR.

A task/grain/minimum-cell law says which H are permitted. It does not say how probability is distributed among permitted plans. “The prior over H must be the C3 law” turns possible into probable. A MAP plan is undefined from `p(O|H,theta)` alone; at most one can form a maximum-likelihood plan. Q-A needs a separately named/versioned `p(H | task, eligible mask, grain, ...)`, including cardinality/spacing treatment, or must stay likelihood-only and abstain from MAP language. The decision/acceptance layer then also needs its named loss or threshold.

3. ORDER-PRESERVING ASSOCIATION IS AN ASSUMPTION, NOT A CONSEQUENCE OF POINTS LYING ON A LINE.

Sorting O does not prove that latent-to-observed associations cannot cross. For close h1<h2, independent location errors can produce an observation left of h1 from h2 and one right of h2 from h1. General unlabeled set detection sums over those injection hypotheses too. The O(m*n) sequence-alignment sum is lawful only under an explicit monotone edit-channel/no-swap generative assumption (or a kernel/support condition that proves crossings impossible). Otherwise the general association sum returns.

Required courts: a two-close-boundary swap case with positive kernel mass, plus a declared no-swap positive control. If the model excludes the first, state and calibrate that exclusion; do not derive it from sorting provider output.

4. “AN EXTRA NEARBY PROPOSAL IS PENALIZED, NEVER REWARDED” DOES NOT FOLLOW.

The sum over matchings creates new association terms when an observation is added, and an added gap may legitimately match a previously missed second latent boundary. Raw probabilities of sets with different cardinality are not ordered by a general monotonicity theorem. `f` and `c` do not establish one by name.

The actual court should be hypothesis-relative: redundant emissions around ONE latent boundary from ONE call must not count as independent support for that boundary, while a second real latent boundary remains detectable. Compare posterior/likelihood ratios under frozen competing H and a normalized clutter/count model. Do not require the raw likelihood of every denser set to decrease.

5. CALL DEPENDENCE IS STILL UNSPECIFIED, SO CALL-GROUP/DEPENDENCE COURTS ARE NOT YET SATISFIED.

A per-call set likelihood solves within-call multiplicity. It does not say how shared model family, prompt, tokenizer, training source, retry or derived calls combine. “Handled one level up” correctly names the gap but cannot simultaneously count as satisfying R4.5. Fail closed to a labeled family or dependence-bounded sensitivity analysis until the joint/coupling model is named; multiplying per-call likelihoods would recreate fabricated independent support.

6. P2 BLOCKS CALIBRATION UNDER THIS SUPERVISED ROUTE; IT DOES NOT LOGICALLY BLOCK SPECIFYING Q-A.

“There is no other source” is an impossibility claim and is too strong. Replicate-rater latent-class/error models can estimate error parameters without a gold label under additional identifiability assumptions; whether those assumptions are acceptable here is a scientific decision. More importantly, this thread already distinguished calibration targets: adjudicated exact gaps, a human boundary distribution, and a task-loss-optimal region are not interchangeable. P2 supplies protocol-defined reference observations, not metaphysical “true boundaries.”

Correct dependency: Q-A's state space and normalized generative contract can be specified now. Fitting, validating, and using calibrated probabilities under the proposed supervised route requires P2 calibration-grade reference data for the NAMED target; Accepted remains unavailable until that succeeds. Q-B is then the critical path to calibrated M4 exit, not to writing down Q-A.

VERDICT

Retain this family as the Q-A strawman, not as a settled model. The next revision should publish: the normalized set/base-measure and clutter law; a separate lawful-plan prior or explicit likelihood-only status; the no-crossing assumption or general association alternative; the cross-call dependence layer; the exact calibration target; and normalization/identifiability/posterior-calibration courts. The O(m*n) result is promising if the monotone channel is scientifically defensible, but it is conditional, not free.

No implementation, vocabulary, dependency, ADR, bead, path, reservation, data import, or authority claimed.
